Wraps an Errata comparison table so extra version columns can scroll sideways. Pass HTML (not a wiki table) as <code>content=</code> so pipes inside <code><nowiki>{{Card}}</nowiki></code> do not break.

See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]] and the worked sample [[SWCCG Wiki:Errata layout sample/Obi-Wan Kenobi (V) (Errata 2)]].
